text:
Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document out lines Lube oil system maintenance 
procedure I1, which to be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The System consists 
of R5502, GT 4033, R 1587, R 4591, R1586, R1588, R5201, R5205, 5206, R5210 GT 
4031.
The first draft initiated 
 by eng. Mohmed Aly Aly 
Hassan, tested at 01 Jan. 2003 by eng. 
 Al Shahat Ahmed Mousa,
 reviewed by eng. 
 Abd Almonem Alemam,
 revised by quality 
 control engineer, accepted by General Manger eng. Hamdy Melegy 
 and approved by eng.Yousry Mohamed Aly Salama Al Shabab Power Station Sector Head.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.
Gas turbine should be out of service at cold state.
Oil pumps ( AC DC ) off ( All mcc. C.B Risk out)
Tools and Equipment
Vernier hight
Pressure tester > 20 bar.
Multimeter and connection wire.
Air blower, Contact cleaner.
Vernier hight
Wrench spanner 
 set
Work to be Carried Out
Pressure 
Switch
Disconnect the oil path to the pressure switch (PS)
Connect the oil pump to PS
Fix the pressure of pump at 0.9 bar
Disconnect the terminal 1 or 2 to control circuits
Measure the resistance of PS, 
 open and close values ref. to setting values as in test sheet
Constant Pressure Valve (CPV)
Release the lock of CPV
Measure the pressure value if not 
 OK adjust the length
